name: AgentActivity
description: A short summary of what the assistant is doing or did, such as "Used 3 tools", that opens into each step. It stays open while a step needs approval.

onApprove.description: Called with a tool's id when the person approves it.

onDeny.description: Called with a tool's id when the person declines it.

focusApproval.description: Move focus to an approval box when one appears.

keyboard: Enter / Space on the summary: shows or hides the steps
requirements: The summary is a button with aria-expanded that controls the list of steps
While any step is waiting for approval the list is forced open and the button is disabled: a question can't be hidden
Progress reads in words ("Working: 1 of 3 steps done"), failures and declines are counted
Each step is a ToolCall, so it announces its own changes
screenReader: While working: "Working: 1 of 3 steps done, button, collapsed"

use_when: Grouping the tool calls inside one reply
avoid_when: A single tool call: use ToolCall directly
anti_patterns: Collapsing the list while an approval is pending
